name: lastid-agent-runtime
description: Runtime package for the lastid-agent plugin (deps installed on-demand by bin/lastid-agent.js on first run).
comment_optionalEmbeddings: @xenova/transformers (~137MB) is intentionally NOT a dependency — installing it in the fast first-run bootstrap would stall the MCP server past the runtime's connect timeout. It is opt-in via `lastid-agent memory-setup`, which installs it on demand. Memory search degrades to keyword scoring until then.
